title: Nimbus 38
text: Cabin-sized travel pack that opens flat like a suitcase, padded laptop sleeve, hideaway harness.

title: Fellcraft 55
text: Load-hauling trekking pack with an adjustable back length and a proper hip belt for heavy weeks.

title: Shoal 22
text: Light daypack for city use, water bottle pockets, no frame, folds into its own lid when empty.

title: Wayfen 40 Pro
text: Rugged carry-on with a waterproof shell, lockable zips and a separate compartment for wet kit.

title: Orrin 30
text: Simple top-loading pack in recycled canvas, one big compartment, leather straps, no laptop sleeve.

title: Kestrel Lite 45
text: Ultralight frameless 45 litre pack for fast trips, thin shoulder straps, minimal padding, very light.

title: Brackwell Carryall
text: Convertible duffel and backpack with a clamshell opening and compression straps for a week away.

title: Granite Vale 65
text: Expedition pack with a floating lid, ice axe loops and a heavily padded belt. Overkill for cities.

title: Pilot 28
text: Commuter pack with a padded laptop sleeve, quick-access top pocket and a luggage pass-through.

title: Tarnhead 50
text: Mid-size trekking pack with a ventilated mesh back panel, rain cover included, comfortable loaded.

title: Ferry 18
text: Tiny packable bag that lives inside another pack, useful as a second bag, no structure at all.

title: Helm 36 Waterproof
text: Fully welded waterproof roll-top, one main compartment, tough enough for a bike but heavy for its size.

title: Cairnway 42
text: Hybrid travel and hiking pack, removable daypack on the front, adjustable harness, fits most cabins.

title: Linden 25
text: Smart-looking city pack in coated cotton, laptop sleeve, magnetic closure, not remotely waterproof.

title: Brindle 60
text: Cheap large trekking pack, basic harness, plenty of external straps, heavy for the volume it carries.

title: Sable Carry 35
text: Understated carry-on with a clamshell main section, compression panel and a padded laptop pocket.

title: Moorline 48
text: Front-loading travel pack with lockable zips and stowable straps, made for long-haul bus and train trips.

title: Ashen 20 Run
text: Running vest style pack with bottle pockets on the chest, bounces very little, useless for luggage.

title: Quarry 44 Tough
text: Heavy-duty pack in thick ballistic nylon, will survive baggage handlers, punishing to carry all day.

title: Petrel 32
text: Well-priced weekend pack, side access to the main compartment, small laptop sleeve, light enough to forget.
